title: Founding Senior Engineer
description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
THE COMPANY

Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing - you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.
What We're Looking For:

• 5+ years of experience at 2-3+ tech-focused companies

• Expert knowledge of React/TypeScript

• Expert knowledge of HTML/CSS

• Solid grasp of UX design fundamentals and the ability to translate an idea into reasonable basic UI

The more experience with any/all of these, the better:

• GraphQL

• Chakra or another UI component toolkit

• React Native

• Solid knowledge of HTTP protocol

• Even more UX design skills than mentioned above

• Writing GraphQL resolvers on the backend

• MongoDB

• AWS Cognito/Lambda/DocumentDB/API Gateway/CloudFormation

• Writing good technical documentation

• Working knowledge of managed cloud-service software development, esp. AWS

• Working knowledge of building software in containerized deployments, with full CI/CD

• A passion for leading and mentoring engineers

• A desire to work directly with customers (winemaker customer visits are pretty great)

About Zero21

As recruiters helping to build the next generation of industry disruptors, we are committed to expanding the startup ecosystem so that exceptional talent from diverse communities can gain greater access to more early stage companies.
We work only with equal opportunity employers who welcome candidates from underrepresented, underestimated, and traditionally overlooked communities to further diversity, equity, and inclusion in the next cohort of industry-disrupting unicorns.
To all recruitment agencies: Zero21 does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or our team members. Zero21 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Head of Product
description:
About Hashgraph:

Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera is EVM-compatible and has been specifically built to meet the needs of enterprise and web3 applications, which require speed, security, stability and sustainability. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralized platform.

Why this role exists:

Assets are landing on ledgers faster than anyone has built a way to move them between ledgers. Collateral sits on one chain while the position it should be margining sits on another. Delivery-versus-payment and payment-versus-payment both work inside a single ledger and both break the moment the two legs live in different places. The available workarounds are bridges, which have lost more than $2.8 billion since 2021.

The team that built Hedera from the ground up is now building a cross-ledger solution for institutional settlement: collateral mobility, DvP, PvP, cross-border payments, and FX across public and private ledgers that do not otherwise interoperate.

Your job will be to define the product and own the roadmap. You will report to the founder.

In this role, you will:

- Own the product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and roadmap.

- Work closely with business development on go-to-market execution for the product. Define the product the market needs and business development can sell..

- Report product status and roadmap changes directly to the founders and executive team.

- Design and run trials with external validators, partners, and customers.

- Make the release readiness call on performance, security, and usability. Ask the tough questions before launch, not after.

- Run program management across every stakeholder group. Keep BD, Marketing, and Engineering in sync.

What success looks like in 12 months:

- Live settlement for the priority use cases of cross-border payments, settlements, treasury management, and tokenized deposits, with named institutional counterparties moving real value.

- You will have built working on/off-ramps supporting the use cases above.

- BD, marketing, and engineering each independently say you are the reason they are shipping faster.

What you bring:

Core capabilities:

- 10+ years in product management, product leadership, or an equivalent operating role.

- 5+ years of that inside FX, payments, settlement, clearing, custody, collateral management, or banking infrastructure.

- Real operating experience in FX exchange, payments, settlement, or banking-rail businesses. You understand cross-border payments, stablecoins, on/off-ramps, and how players like SWIFT and Stripe fit together.

- Direct working knowledge of at least two of: FX execution and settlement, cross-border payments, DvP or PvP settlement, collateral mobility, treasury operations, tokenized deposits.

Functional expertise:

- Experience owning a roadmap end to end, including making the right, hard calls.

- Experience writing product requirements that an engineering team built from directly.

- Experience presenting to executives, boards, or institutional steering committees.

Preferred skills and experience:

- Distributed ledger or Layer 1 experience.

- Work inside a consortium, governing council, or member-owned network model.

- Exposure to CCIP, Circle and ARC, Canton, Ripple, or comparable enterprise platforms.

- Stablecoin mechanics, on-ramps and off-ramps, tokenized collateral.

- First product hire or zero-to-one experience at an early-stage company.

Candidates who meet the basic qualifications and none of the preferred should still apply. The preferred list is learnable in a quarter.

Travel to customer, validator, and partner sites, including international travel will be required.

title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
description:
ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams.

- Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes.

- Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts.

- Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking.

- Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership.

- Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness.

- Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed.

- Mentor other product managers and help build the team.

ABOUT YOU:

- 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product.

- Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue.

- Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, entitlements, metering APIs, and disbursements.

- Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, marketplace, and partner channels, including dunning and delinquency flows, fraud detection, and payment notifications.

- Strong understanding of order-to-cash, including invoicing, payment processing, tax, multi-currency, ERP integration, and revenue recognition.

- Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor.

- A track record of designing and maturing a product area from v1 and leading complex programs across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to executives and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences.

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company.

- Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself.

- Speaking or published thought leadership on usage-based pricing, billing, or cloud marketplaces.

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a r

title: On-Chain Researcher - Alpha Generation & Market Structure
description:
Company Overview
hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced crypto-native researcher to join our alpha-generating research team at hermeneutic Investments .
The ideal candidate combines deep on-chain analytical capability with strong market intuition and a demonstrated ability to independently generate trade ideas. This role is focused on identifying actionable opportunities across crypto markets through blockchain analysis, market structure research, real-time event interpretation, and exploratory data analysis.
Candidates should possess strong familiarity with Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and major non-EVM blockchains, alongside the ability to rapidly investigate unfamiliar protocols, entities, and market events. Successful researchers in this role are highly self-sufficient: they are capable of independently sourcing data, navigating APIs and SQL datasets, leveraging modern analytical and LLM tooling, and rapidly validating hypotheses under time pressure.
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy uncovering informational and structural market inefficiencies through deep technical investigation and creative research.
Responsibilities
Alpha Generation & Research

• Generate differentiated trade ideas through on-chain analysis, market structure understanding, and thematic research.

• Identify emerging trends, positioning imbalances, capital flows, behavioral patterns, and structural inefficiencies across crypto markets.

• Rapidly investigate market-moving events and determine whether observed activity represents noise, positioning, or actionable signal.

• Conduct exploratory research across Bitcoin, EVM ecosystems, and non-EVM blockchains to identify asymmetric opportunities.

• Use on-chain activity, market behavior, and historical context to develop actionable trading insights.

• Continually evaluate new analytical frameworks, datasets, and publicly available research to improve research capabilities and thematic coverage.

Blockchain Analysis

• Perform detailed entity attribution, wallet clustering, and transaction graph analysis across both account-based and UTXO-based blockchains.

• Analyze Bitcoin transaction flows, miner activity, ETF and exchange flows, treasury activity, and cross-venue capital movement.

• Investigate token supply dynamics including genesis distributions, insider activity, vesting, staking, governance, treasury management, and unlock schedules.

• Monitor consensus mechanisms, validator behavior, bridge activity, and broader blockchain infrastructure dynamics.

• Evaluate unfamiliar blockchain networks, protocols, and ecosystems when new opportunities arise.

Data & Tooling

• Independently source, query, and analyze blockchain and market datasets using SQL and API endpoints for internal data platforms.

• Navigate complex blockchain data schemas to rapidly validate hypotheses and support trading decisions.

• Leverage LLM and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate exploratory analysis, attribution workflows, summarization, and ad hoc research.

• Prototype analytical workflows and research tooling prior to involving engineering resources where appropriate.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to improve internal analytics frameworks, monitoring systems, datasets, and research tooling.

Real-Time Monitoring & Market Awareness

title: Gas Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

Role Scope

- Negotiate behind-the-meter PPAs, tolling agreements, and heat rate options with generation owners and developers for multi-hundred-megawatt data center campuses.

- Negotiate gas supply, transport, and basis arrangements that lock in fuel price and deliverability for each behind-the-meter site before the build starts.

- Diligence prospective behind-the-meter gas sites for pipeline access, fuel constraints, air permitting, and power delivery risk before we commit to a lease.

- Evaluate generation equipment (for example turbines and reciprocating engines) on heat rate, availability, lead time, emissions, and delivered cost, and turn it into a clear recommendation for leadership.

- Quarterback development, engineering, legal, and finance from site selection through executed supply contracts to energization, and flag cost and schedule exposure before it reaches leadership.

What We’re Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don’t fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You’ve personally negotiated behind-the-meter PPAs, tolls, or heat rate options where the economics had to hold through project finance and final deal terms.

- You’ve negotiated gas supply agreements and managed fixed-price, index, and basis exposure, and you know which fuel constraints break a plant’s dispatch.

- You’ve diligenced a gas-fired site from pipeline access and fuel deliverability through air permits and power delivery, and you know what kills a site early.

- You’ve compared generation technologies on heat rate, spark-spread economics, and reliability, and your analysis drove an equipment decision.

- You’ve built the techno-economic models behind these deals and defended the sensitivities to lenders, investors, or executives.

- You quarterback across engineering, legal, finance, and operations, and you write clearly enough to distill a technical question into a decision and a next step for a CEO.

- Bonus: Multi-market power experience (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, WECC). Plant dispatch and fuel optimization (generator, asset manager, or trading desk). Large-load and utility interconnection. Pipeline capacity and midstream contracting.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: IT Help Desk Manager
description:
About DMI

DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. Recognized as a Top Workplace, DMI is committed to delivering secure, efﬁcient, and cost-effective solutions that drive measurable results. Learn more at www.dminc.com
About the Opportunity
DMI , LLC is seeking an experienced and highly organized IT Help Desk Manager to oversee our IT support operations for a federal government contract. The IT Help Desk Manager will be responsible for leading a team of help desk professionals, ensuring exceptional customer service, troubleshooting technical issues, and maintaining IT systems that support federal operations. This position requires in-depth knowledge of IT infrastructure, federal regulations, and the ability to effectively manage and optimize help desk operations.
Duties and Responsibilities:

• Leadership & Team Management:

• Supervise, mentor, and manage a team of IT help desk technicians, ensuring the efficient and effective resolution of user issues.

• Develop training materials and provide ongoing training to staff to enhance technical skills and customer service.

• Conduct performance reviews and offer feedback for continuous improvement.

• Foster a collaborative and solution-oriented team culture.

• Service Desk Operations:

• Oversee the day-to-day activities of the IT help desk, including managing ticketing systems, troubleshooting, and escalating complex issues to appropriate technical teams.

• Ensure timely and accurate resolution of incidents and service requests, adhering to established SLAs.

• Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction by providing professional, clear, and courteous communication.

• Technical Support & Troubleshooting:

• Provide hands-on support for end-user hardware and software issues, including desktop, laptop, mobile devices, and peripherals.

• Support federal IT systems, including desktops, servers, networks, and other technologies in compliance with federal standards and regulations.

• Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal teams to resolve complex technical issues.

• Compliance & Security:

• Ensure adherence to all relevant federal regulations, including cybersecurity policies, privacy standards, and operational security protocols.

• Conduct regular audits and risk assessments to ensure compliance with federal IT requirements and best practices.

• Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to manage vulnerabilities and maintain secure IT infrastructure.

• Reporting & Continuous Improvement:

• Develop and maintain detailed reports on help desk performance, including metrics on incident resolution times, customer satisfaction, and issue trends.

• Analyze performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement process improvements.

• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends, integrating them into IT operations as appropriate.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:

The engineer will leverage cloud native networking and security controls-including security groups / NSGs, NACLs / Azure Firewall rules, AWS Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, WAF (AWS/Azure), and DDoS protection (AWS Shield / Azure DDoS Protection)-to build resilient, well architected systems aligned with best practices.

• Collaborate closely with development, security, and operations teams to deploy and support cloud based applications, services, and platforms across AWS and Azure.

• Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, Terraform, Ansible, and other infrastructure as code tools.

• Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, and conduct capacity planning using CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ensuring reliable and efficient cloud operations.

• Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including IAM / Azure AD RBAC governance, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance with frameworks such as HIPAA and Sarbanes Oxley.

• Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure and networking issues across AWS and Azure, performing root cause analysis and driving long term remediation.

• Continuously evaluate emerging cloud services, tools, and architectural patterns across AWS and Azure to improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and cross functional team members.

• Create and maintain detailed documentation for architecture, operational processes, standards, and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Skills

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering

Über uns:

Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.

Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben - indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten kannst du beweisen, dass Dinge anders - und besser - gemacht werden können.

Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.

Unsere Technology:

Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.

Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.

Die Rolle

Als Werkstudent/in im Bereich Fördermittelmanagement erhältst du spannende Einblicke in die Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Projektförderung und Digitalisierung. Du unterstützt unser Finance-Team bei öffentlich geförderten Forschungsprojekten und arbeitest an Themen wie Reporting, Datenaufbereitung und Prozessoptimierung.

Bei uns kannst du Finance nicht nur im Tagesgeschäft kennenlernen, sondern auch aktiv mitgestalten: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Abläufe, entwickeln neue Prozesse und nutzen moderne Technologien wie KI, um unsere Arbeit effizienter zu machen. Wenn du gerne mit Zahlen arbeitest, neugierig auf neue Technologien bist und eigene Ideen einbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf dich!

Das sollte dich begeistern

- Einblicke in die Finanzierung öffentlich geförderter Forschungsprojekte und Mitarbeit am Fördermittelreporting

- Analyse und Prüfung von Finanz- und Stundendaten sowie Unterstützung bei finanziellen Nachweisen

- Mitgestaltung digitaler und KI-gestützter Prozesse zur Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Finance-Abläufe

- Mitarbeit bei der Einführung unseres neuen ERP-Systems und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Daten- und Reportingstrukturen

Das bringst du idealerweise mit

- Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und zuverlässig, bist gut organisiert und kommunizierst gerne

- Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und gehst sicher mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, um

- Du bist IT-affin, lernst gerne Neues und hast Interesse an Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI. Kenntnisse in SAP sind ein Plus

Unsere Kultur

Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können.

Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

Ihre Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Dein Wohlbefinden steht an erster Stelle. Wir bieten dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit hervorragenden Versic

title: Fleet Manager - Last Mile(Delhi) - Contractual
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. As Fleet Coordinator - Last Mile, you will own day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across our hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR - making sure passengers move smoothly between buses and cabs, cab operators deliver to standard, and your ground team runs like clockwork.

About The Role

• Lead and manage day-to-day last-mile ground operations and real-time traffic control across designated hubs and pickup/drop points in Delhi NCR.

• Ensure smooth, timely dispatch and coordination of last-mile cabs against bus arrival and departure schedules.

• Act as the on-ground escalation point, resolving operational disruptions (delays, no-shows, route changes, demand surges) quickly and calmly.

• Work closely with last-mile cab operators and drivers to drive app adoption, improve punctuality metrics, and elevate customer experience.

• Coach and support drivers on FlixBus standards, app usage, and service expectations.

• Manage the roster, shift planning, and day-to-day working of ground operations associates and last-mile associates.

• Allocate manpower against demand patterns and peak windows; track attendance, performance, and productivity of the ground team.

• Own last-mile cab operator governance - share performance reports regularly, run periodic review meetings, and manage the day-to-day partner relationship.

• Track operator SLAs and KPIs, flag underperformance, and drive corrective action plans.

• Be the owner of last-mile passenger experience, ensuring a smooth transition from buses to cabs and cabs to buses.

• Monitor passenger feedback and complaints related to the last mile, close the loop, and drive continuous improvement.

About You

• 3-6 years of experience in ground operations, last-mile logistics, fleet coordination, transport operations, or a similar field (mobility, ride-hailing, e-commerce delivery, or aggregator platforms preferred).

• Proven experience managing frontline teams and third-party vendors or operators.

• Strong grasp of punctuality/SLA-driven operations and comfort working with real-time, on-ground decision-making.

• Data-literate - comfortable working with dashboards, spreadsheets, and reporting; able to turn numbers into action.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to hold operators accountable while maintaining strong relationships.

• Customer-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.

• Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to work in shifts, be on-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.

• Bachelor's degree preferred; proficiency in English and Hindi.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling start-up .

• Play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless execution of our intercity travel operations, ground operational excellence, data analysis and vendor management processes.

• Hone your stakeholder management skills by interacting with international stakeholders.

Why Join Flix

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you’re looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo's Systems Engineering team works together to blend software and hardware systems in groundbreaking new ways. We set the high performance standards that ensure our vehicles run smoothly and keep passengers safe, then design and perform the tests that validate that performance. We're looking for talented teammates who’ll help us maintain strong teamwork and are passionate about driving results.

Why This Team is Essential to Waymo's Success: 

Waymo is undergoing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities (targeting ~20 new cities by EOY 2026) and launching new vehicle platforms. Scenario Ops plays a critical role in this expansion, making it possible to scale safely and efficiently. The team owns the scaled delivery and maintenance of simulation-based directed testing coverage used to evaluate the Safety and performance of the driver as Waymo continues to scale. 

In this hyrbid role, you will be reporting to a Staff Program Manager

You will:

• Design Scalable Quality Architecture: Move the organization towards scalable QC (Quality Control) methodologies for test creation (e.g., statistical sampling, risk-based auditing, and automated validation). Be the primary architect of how we verify work at increased scale

You find where work is manual or where data goes unused, build a solution that works in one area, such as paid marketing, lifecycle, sales handovers or content, and then reuse it across the others. You work closely with our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, the Demand Generation Manager and the Marketing Lead, and you ship things with a business outcome attached, not infrastructure for its own sake. You'll be the first engineer in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how our growth stack is built, not just maintain a fixed setup.

What you'll do

- You automate marketing and lifecycle operations: triggers, segments, workflows and personalization in ActiveCampaign and Salesforce, so journeys react to what customers do.

- You automate paid marketing: audience syncs and suppression from CRM and product data, conversion data fed back to the ad platforms, and campaign feeds and landing pages that adapt to where bids are missing on the Marketplace. Demand Generation owns strategy and budget; you build the machinery.

- You build the data and signal plumbing: product events, Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, enrichment, transaction history and our BigQuery warehouse, connected, clean and usable.

- You automate creative production: ad, email and landing-page variants inside our brand templates, with human review before anything goes live.

- You build once and reuse everywhere: what works in one area becomes a reusable capability for paid, lifecycle, sales and content.

- You find the manual work and the unused data, such as reporting, list building, call transcripts and enrichment, and replace it with automation and LLM-based tools, including the content engine for SEO and AI search.

- You give the team fast experimentation: reusable test set-ups, holdouts and measurement, so tests launch in days, not weeks.

- You launch with care: human checks in every automation, proof against a control or holdout before you scale, and a launch plan with scope, review steps, rollout and rollback.

What You Bring

- You've built marketing or growth automation that runs in production: paid media integrations, CRM and lifecycle workflows, data pipelines, ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business.

- You're hands-on with APIs, webhooks and automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier or Clay; Python and SQL is a must; TypeScript is a strong plus.

- You know ad platform and CRM data: audiences, conversion tracking and the limits of attribution.

- You've shipped LLM-based or agentic automation into a real workflow, not just used AI to write copy faster.

- You think in outcomes: a working use case in two weeks beats a platform in six months, and you measure what you build.

- You're careful with what goes live: you check outputs by hand, test against a control before you trust a result, and plan launches step by step with a way back.

- You work well with marketers and explain trade-offs plainly.

- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Your Benefits

- Room to shape and grow: The first engineer in Marketing, deciding how our growth stack is built.

- AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better - and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval.

- Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

- Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours.

- Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

- A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events.

Vincent Sternberg · Vorsitzender des Klinikbeirats, Gründer PraxisEins-Gruppe

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

You'll join at an exciting point: a strong SDR foundation is in place, new starters are joining, and more hires are planned as we grow. We're an AI company, and our outbound motion should prove it.

This role is measured in pipeline dollars and revenue, not activity. If you've carried a closing number, built something real with AI, and get energy from developing people and watching your team win, we'd love to hear from you.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

- Own outbound pipeline for our Corporate and Mid-Market segments in North America, with targets set in pipeline dollars and revenue

- Lead and grow a team of SDRs, with more headcount planned

- Stay hands-on as a player-coach: prospect, open new accounts, and coach in the moment

- Build the AI agents, automations and signal-based workflows that let a lean team cover a large market, starting with ElevenLabs' own products

ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry's Infrastructure Engineering team is what makes operating Sentry simple, safe, and seamless for every other engineering team in the company. They build the internal control platforms, configuration systems, traffic routing, and automation that let product engineers operate services safely at scale without needing deep infrastructure expertise themselves.

As the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure Engineering, you'll lead a team of engineers building the tools that power Sentry's growth: internal admin and change management tools, configuration automation, and the routing layer that underlies Sentry's architecture. You'll be responsible for technical vision, team health, system reliability, and partnership with engineering teams across the company who depend on your team's tools every day.

You'll work closely with leaders across Infrastructure, Platform, and Production Engineering to shape how Sentry scales its operational model as the company grows.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Lead a team of engineers building the internal control platforms that every engineering team at Sentry relies on to operate services safely.

- Drive the evolution of Infrastructure Engineering's platform, including configuration management, traffic routing and environment controls

- Own the team's technical direction, contributing to key decisions on API architecture, internal tooling design, and automation frameworks.

- Nurture and grow engineers at different levels, providing support through coaching, mentorship, and career development.

- Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture focused on ownership, learning, and delivery.

- Partner with Production Engineering, SRE, and Developer Infrastructure to make sure operational tooling stays consistent and well-scoped across the org.

- Own the reliability, adoption, and roadmap of the team's tools while building a culture of technical excellence and pragmatic decision making.

YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- Are passionate about building tools that make operating complex systems simple for other engineers.

- Enjoy solving infrastructure problems around configuration, routing, and automation, and turning them into clean, self-service abstractions.

- Believe in using proven technologies and committing to a single, reliable choice rather than chasing novelty.

- Think in terms of building for scale and cost effectiveness from day one, and for the needs of many teams rather than one.

- Value cross-functional collaboration and thrive in hybrid, in-person settings with engineers across functions, levels, and geographies.

- Take pride in building strong, healthy teams and enabling them to lead high-impact, multi-year initiatives.

- Want to be part of a thoughtful, highly technical team that cares about long-term system health and operational simplicity.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a focus on internal tooling, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, or distributed systems.

- 4+ years of engineering management experience, including growing and managing teams of engineers.

- Experience as a Tech Lead or Engineering Manager leading the architecture and long-term evolution of internal control platforms or similar systems.

- Strong backend or full-stack engineering background, with solid Python skills.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, terraform, python, and a systems mindset for abstracting complex infrastructure for others to use.

- Strong technical communication skills and a track record of effective cross-team and leadership collaboration.

title: Customer Success Manager - US
description:
About You

You’re a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You’re a self-starter who’s good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You’ve worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they’re happy they partnered with you. Further, you’re a curious person, and you’d love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

ABOUT US

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

About the Position

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

- Repaying our customers’ trust through ensuring they get live with our product and are thrilled with the results

- Understand the needs and roles within the enterprise organizations we work with and help to manage prioritizations and misalignments. If two people within a customer ask for different things, your team must understand how to prioritize for the success of the organization without hurting feelings

- Helping craft and dictate both internal and external narratives for what’s needed to make a customer successful

- Effectively asking for and managing engineering time to ensure important work for customers is prioritized and unimportant requests are resolved with minimal to no engineering resources

- Fielding and troubleshooting customer support requests

- Creating and updating customer documentation and training materials as needed

- Always looking for new ways you can make our integration process more robust and make customers feel even more successful

Requirements

- A minimum of three years professional experience dealing directly with customers and large organizations in a role within customer success, technical account management, or solutions consulting

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Know what an API is and have interacted with them before

- Excellent ability to quickly understand the different roles in an organization, focus on the ones most important to a task, and craft clear narrative to get people behind your ideas

- Ability to convince and motivate those around you to do what you know is

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer
Would you enjoy working with large distributed systems ?
Do you enjoy using your expertise to mentor others ?
Join our cutting-edge Web Security Team
Our team develops and sells Akamai's carrier network security products to fixed and mobile network service providers. We specialize in delivering highly scalable network infrastructure and access-based security products to our customers. We collaborate with product groups, external partners to enable our customers to provide high-quality, secure internet and network access to their end-users.
Develop secure, reliable and maintainable code
As Software Engineer.Senior , you'll develop software that runs one of the largest distributed-systems in the world. You will play a key role in our growth strategy. You'll be creating innovative solutions for our network challenges and clients, with the aim of increasing internet traffic and making it faster, more reliable and secure.
As a Software Engineer Senior , you will be responsible for:

• Collaborating with other software engineering teams to influence and shape the design process and product development

• Creating and enhancing new features and functionality, including conception, design, testing and deployment

• Being the subject matter and team expert, leading and mentoring others to optimize their productivity

• Working with internal teams to troubleshoot complex problems in our network for our customers

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have 3+ years in experience in software development life cycles and writing code in Golang/C/C++ within a Unix/Linux environment

• Have understanding of how internet and it's networks/protocols (IP, DNS, routing, HTTP, TCP or web architecture) works

• Demonstrate a keen interest in learning new technologies

• Be a natural communicator with an interest in mentoring others using your subject matter expertise

• Have experience in cloud platforms such as AWS/GCP/Azure etc

• Be adept on Cloud native constructs and deployments

•
Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We’re doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it’s important that you’re able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as Linkedin Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.
